1. Capella

    * [Shanghai testnet](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/688#issuecomment-1351488898)
    * spec items
        * [historical batch revamp](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2649)

3. 4844
    * [Protocol upgrade name](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/688#issuecomment-1351704592)
    * [DA on historic blocks](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3141)
    * [No blob available error code](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3154)
1. Research, spec, etc
1. Open Discussion/Closing Remark

comments.body:
I'd like to also discuss the difference in storage formats between EL block header, and CL `ExecutionPayloadHeader`.
- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3078

[hexssz.pdf](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/files/10237672/hexssz.pdf)

I'd like to propose a the first shanghai based testnet and would like to discuss scope/spec versions needed to join as well as set some parameters like validator size/important withdrawal tests to run.

Since ACD accepted EIP-4844 to be included in the protocol upgrade after Capalla/Shanghai, I'd like to get a rough consensus on the name of the protocol upgrade after Capella. The earlier we decide it, the fewer broken links.

- [@timbeiko's magicians thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/rfc-post-merge-network-upgrade-naming-schemes/11977)
- @protolambda [nominated "Dubhe" 🐻](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/rfc-post-merge-network-upgrade-naming-schemes/11977/9).
    > Dubhe would be my strong preference for star name after Capella: it’s the traditional/formal name for Alpha Ursae Majoris, also known as the “Big Dipper” and “Great Bear”: the ideal name to close a bear market with. 
- Welcome other nominations and/or we can get community feedback via poll.

~~On the spec front, I would like to merge this PR assuming no concerns have arisen since the last call. 
https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/224~~

Got my time wrong by an hour, nevermind. Chat in the new year. :)
